summary: Incyte Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a settlement agreement with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services regarding the application of Medicaid rebate rules to Opzelura cream. The agreement resolves litigation by confirming CMS will not treat Opzelura as a line extension of Jakafi. Incyte withdrew its lawsuit and expects a one-time non-cash benefit of ~$246M in Q2 2026 from reversing accrued liabilities, plus ongoing gross-to-net improvement. This is a legal and accounting event, not a special situation like M&A or restructuring.
